task_title: AUG-162: a JEV check stamp travels only with a verdict it actually produced — the -1 sentinel beside a real jev_checked_at is gone, the no-call path says so out loud, the outage path stays fail-closed, and the live arm can no longer red the whole gate on a transient miss (fix 6b77fc1, graded at the merged head; AC5 gate-green leg is graded by tier1 tests)
task_criteria: Board AC1: a question the gate never examined carries NO check stamp — with auger.recall forced to return no hits, `feedback --budget 1` stores the follow-up row with jev_checked_at == "" and jev_already_answered == -1.0, spends ZERO JEV calls, and prints the "not gated ... no JEV verdict was produced" line. FAILIF: the run stamps a real jev_checked_at beside -1, makes a JEV call, or prints no such line (this test is RED against the pre-fix auger.py at 425c846). PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_auger.py -k no_evidence_could_answer

Board AC2: a JEV outage stays fail-closed AND is classifiable as a loud skip — with the gate forced to return (None, "", "", "all 6 JEV keys failed; last: HTTP 401 User not found"), `feedback --budget 1` exits 1, stores no follow-up, prints "WARNING gate unavailable" naming the JEV failure, and live_unavailable_reason(out) returns a skip reason naming JEV+401 for that output and "" for an ordinary transcript. FAILIF: the outage path stores a row, exits 0, is not named as a skip, or the classifier skips an ordinary transcript. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_auger.py -k jev_unavailable

Board AC3: the live arm requires the two gate columns to AGREE instead of requiring a model verdict — test_feedback_live_proposes_gates_and_asks_a_real_question asserts bool(jev_checked_at) == (jev_already_answered >= 0) and still asserts the row exists, is trackable (opens edge to D-002) and matches its status branch. FAILIF: the assertion is back to requiring a numeric verdict, or the row/trackability assertions were dropped. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs tests/test_auger.py -k feedback_live

Board AC4: the answered path keeps its POSITIVE assertion in a distinct test — test_feedback_turns_a_thin_decision_into_a_named_followup still requires a numeric noul (0.10) together with a stamped check, and propagate no longer writes a sentinel verdict for a question it did not gate. FAILIF: the fix was "delete the assertion", or the answered path no longer requires both a numeric verdict and a stamp. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_auger.py -k "feedback or jev or propagate"

Board AC5 + falsifier provenance: the graded head is the merged tree that CONTAINS the fix and both new falsifiers, and that suite is inside the gate pytest arm (so the proof cannot silently leave CI). FAILIF: 6b77fc1 is not an ancestor of the judged HEAD, either falsifier test is missing, or tests/test_auger.py is absent from tests/gate.sh. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && git merge-base --is-ancestor 6b77fc1 HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$?; grep -c "def test_feedback_stamps_no_gate_check_when_no_evidence_could_answer" tests/test_auger.py; grep -c "def test_jev_unavailable_fails_closed_and_classifies_as_a_loud_skip" tests/test_auger.py; grep -c "tests/test_auger.py" tests/gate.sh

items.criterion: The stamp/verdict agreement invariant holds at EVERY writer of jev_checked_at, not just the feedback path — no writer stores a non-empty jev_checked_at beside jev_already_answered == -1.
items.detail: All three writers agree: auger.py:3567-3578 (feedback) stamps only when verdict is not None; auger.py:2896-2913 (propagate) skips the write entirely on a None verdict and otherwise writes the real verdict; auger.py:4778 (store_proposed_question, the `ask` path) is guarded by auger.py:4731-4732 `if noul is None: return "", "the gate returned no answered-verdict for it"`, so it can never stamp beside a sentinel. Verified by a temporary reviewer probe (tests/test_zz_probe_aug162.py, since deleted) driving propagate with a gate returning (None,"boom"): output "PROBE rc 0 calls 0 ... PROBE q2 -1 '' open" — no stamp, no sentinel, question left open and re-gateable.

items.criterion: The live arm's skip is narrow — it fires only on the CLI's own outage diagnostics and cannot mask a real regression (a non-outage non-zero exit or assertion mismatch still fails).
items.detail: tests/test_auger.py:8351-8368 live_unavailable_reason returns a reason only for lines starting with "WARNING gate unavailable" or "WARNING proposer unavailable"; the skip at :8311-8313 precedes `assert rc == 0` at :8314, so any other non-zero exit still fails that assertion. The classifier is itself falsified by the control at :8424-8426 (ordinary transcript -> ""). The live arm ran to a real pass (`-k feedback_live` -> "1 passed, 336 deselected in 19.71s"), not a skip.

items.criterion: The new "not gated" line is emitted only for the no-verdict case and does not fire on a run that recorded a real numeric verdict.
items.detail: auger.py:3719-3726 computes `ungated = [qid for qid, _did, noul, _text in rep["asked"] if noul is None]` and prints the line only when that list is non-empty, so a numeric-verdict run prints nothing. Confirmed by the answered-path test (noul 0.10, tests/test_auger.py:7954-7957) and the no-evidence test (line present, :8391) both passing in the same run: `-k "feedback or jev or propagate"` -> "28 passed, 309 deselected in 103.18s".
